verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at POST /mcp. Its docs say you can create indexes, add documents, configure settings (ranking rules, searchable attributes, faceting) and run searches using natural-language prompts from any MCP-compatible AI client, and a probe confirms the MCP docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and documentation of which operations are excluded (e.g., keys, tasks, deletion) or what limitations apply.
